niche: how money and the economy work, explained with real public data (inflation, interest rates, money supply, debt, jobs, housing); educational explainers, never personal financial advice
tone: calm, curious, clear storytelling in plain language; precise numbers taken only from the supplied data; no hype, no instructions to the viewer about their money
audience: English-speaking viewers mainly in the US, UK, Canada and Australia; USD unless a chart is about another country; explain jargon the first time it appears
